title: Memory Boundary Verdict
description: Verdict emitted by the memory boundary auditor for one classified file in the fixture workspace. The auditor's job is read-only: classify, attribute, preview. It never moves or persists anything.

path.description: Relative path of the classified file inside the fixture workspace.

classification.description: The boundary category. Migration policy: durable -> persist verbatim; resumable -> persist only if gated on active session; cache -> drop; ambiguous_leakage -> refuse to migrate, surface to operator.

confidence.description: Auditor's confidence in the classification. Below 0.6 the file should be surfaced to the operator, not silently classified.

rationale.description: One-sentence justification citing the rule that fired (frontmatter markers, content shape, layer, or credential-like pattern).

layer.description: Which memory layer the file belongs to. Layered-root resolution: nearest layer wins on name collision, but the conflict itself is reported.

name.description: Memory entry name from frontmatter, or basename if no frontmatter.

supersedes.description: Name of an entry this one supersedes, if any.

action.description: What the migration dry-run would do, never the actual migration.

target_layer.description: Destination memory layer if action != drop/refuse. null for drop/refuse.

warnings.description: Free-form warnings (e.g. 'contains credential-like content', 'name collision with user-layer entry').

examples.rationale: Has name/description frontmatter, status=living, type=project, no session markers.
Filename and contents match credential-like pattern (api_key=, github_pat=, *_key=).

warnings: would be persisted if not flagged
